data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse 'askr' meaning 'ash tree' and 'skil' meaning 'skill' or 'divine ability'. The name Eskill carries the meaning “God's skill, divine ability” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eskill usually hope their child will grow to embody god's skill, divine ability and live with faith, good character and purpose.
